map.逐字符遍历，空白判定为空格 / 制表 / 换行 / 回车；包夹模式输出 emoj: Iterate character by character, treating space / tab / newline / carriage return as whitespace; in wrap mode output emoji + character + emoji, otherwise insert the emoji before and/or after the character according to the options; when skip whitespace is on, whitespace characters are output unchanged without emoji; result length = non-whitespace characters × insertions per character + original character count
